tob_mendelssohn.text: Dreadfully seasick on the crossing, I must tell you. But then the swell comes into the cave and the whole place sings. The rhythm of the waves, the echo of the columns. I shall write it down before I forget.
My sister Fanny will love it. I'll call the overture after the Hebrides, and let the cave take the credit.

tob_staffa_puffin.text: A puffin shuffles on a ledge, looking like a small, stout waiter who has forgotten what he came in for. It is carrying about nine sand eels crosswise in its beak, which is a skill.
